final_answer:
The summarized instructions for resetting a password via email link are as follows:
1. Navigate to the login page.
2. Click 'Forgot Password'.
3. Enter your registered email address.
4. You will receive a password reset link within 5 minutes.
5. The reset link expires after 24 hours for security reasons.
6. If you do not receive the email, check your spam folder or contact support at support@example.com.
7. For security, never share your password with anyone, including support staff. (This information was obtained from multiple documents found in the knowledge base.)
